ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Move
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Show the move gizmo on the selection in the viewport

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Rotate
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Show the rotate gizmo on the selection in the viewport

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Scale
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Show the scale gizmo on the selection in the viewport

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Set Pivot

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Reset
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-restore "><path d="M3.06 13a9 9 0 1 0 .49 -4.087"></path><path d="M3 4.001v5h5"></path><path d="M11 12a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0"></path></svg>

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Lock
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Shown while placing the pivot: confirm this pivot position — rotate and scale turn around it.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Cancel
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Shown while placing the pivot: discard the custom pivot and go back to the selection centre.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Item Pivot
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Shown while placing the pivot: while on, click an item in the 3D view to move the pivot to its centre.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Auto Disable
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-arrows-exchange "><path d="M7 10h14l-4 -4"></path><path d="M17 14h-14l4 4"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Automatically disarm the gizmo, pivot placement and move-to-click when you leave this ribbon: switching to another ribbon tab, or changing layout via the App Layout ribbon or the F-keys. Keeps a mode that reacts to viewport clicks from staying armed while you work elsewhere. A locked pivot is kept — it is a position, not a mode. Default on.

ribbonSelectionTransform.label: Move To Click
ribbonSelectionTransform.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-target-arrow "><path d="M11 12a1 1 0 1 0 2 0a1 1 0 1 0 -2 0"></path><path d="M12 7a5 5 0 1 0 5 5"></path><path d="M13 3.055a9 9 0 1 0 7.941 7.945"></path><path d="M15 6v3h3l3 -3h-3v-3l-3 3"></path><path d="M15 9l-3 3"></path></svg>
ribbonSelectionTransform.tooltip: Arm, then click a point in the 3D view — the selection moves there with its bottom aligned to the clicked point (undoable)
